hero.headline: Run your entire school from one place.
hero.subhead: Zippro School Management System brings academics, attendance, exams, finance, admissions, and more into a single platform built for how schools actually work.

features.heading: Everything your school runs on
features.subheading: Four areas. One platform. Nothing bolted on.

academicsLearning.title: Academics & Learning
academicsLearning.description: Plan the curriculum, run exams and generate report cards, manage the library, and let an AI assistant help staff with the everyday admin work.

studentsPeople.title: Students & People
studentsPeople.description: Handle admissions from first enquiry to enrolment, track attendance daily, keep every student record in one place, give parents visibility, and manage your staff.

operationsFinance.title: Operations & Finance
operationsFinance.description: Collect fees, track spending, manage school supplies and assets, run the school clinic, and keep classrooms and campus facilities organised.

communicationOversight.title: Communication & Oversight
communicationOversight.description: Send announcements, message parents and staff directly, track student conduct, generate the reports your school needs, and manage your public website — all from one admin panel.

pricing.heading: Simple, per-student pricing
pricing.subheading: Pay per student, billed yearly or by term. Every plan includes the modules listed.
